name: Heavy vehicle mass compliance and reporting
summary: Keeps the vehicle register complete enough for mass-limit checks, and queues a note for a person's approval on each vehicle missing a field a vehicle chart needs. The crons read and queue; weighing, mass calculation, permits and regulator lodgement stay with people.

general.evidence: No discovery calls describe this job yet. Steps come from the NHVR platform map.

crons.name: register
crons.summary: Read the vehicle register from Trackunit into the workflow store.

crons.name: mass-check
crons.summary: Queue a register note for approval on each vehicle missing a field a vehicle chart needs.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations only read the vehicle register. The note write replaces the whole note on a Trackunit asset, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

trackunit.covers: vehicle register read; asset note queued for approval

gaps: No discovery calls for this job (the variants file is missing), so the steps come from the NHVR platform map alone.
NHVR Go (nhvr-go): no operations file and no mapped operations. Route Planner, access permit applications and Portal lodgement are not callable and stay manual.
GoCanvas (gocanvas-quarries-and-mines-compliance-templates): read operations are mapped but there is no adapter, because the submission field names are not confirmed in the vendor docs page.
Weighing, GVM, GCM and axle group calculation, and load adjustment: no platform in the kit does these. They stay with the driver or the scale operator.
Regulator reporting: no mapped operation lodges accreditation evidence or mass records.
Trackunit asset records carry no mass fields (no GVM, tare or axle configuration), so the check only tests that the register holds the basic fields a vehicle chart needs. It does not check mass.

assets.updateAssetNote_v2 replaces the whole note, and the kit has no safe read of existing notes (assets.queryAssetNotes_v2 is marked as a write), so the approval cannot show the current note. The approval summary states the overwrite and shows the new text; the approver must read the note in Trackunit before approving.
No 'assets' capability exists in core/capabilities.json, so the workflow declares no capabilities list. A runtime change would be needed to add one.
The Trackunit adapter is docs-only: it needs TRACKUNIT_ACCESS_TOKEN and no sandbox has run it. The page number is taken as zero-based, to confirm on the sandbox.

evidence.calls: 0 discovery calls for this job (the variants file is missing)
evidence.platforms: NHVR Go help pages mapped by hand (partial steps, no operations). Trackunit operations and their spec fields are confirmed in the kit and the vendor spec.
